content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Research & Development Office of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar for a research project in its Department of Mathematics. The project is titled "Bishop-Phelps-Bollobás Properties on Fock Spaces and Modulation Spaces", and the Name of PI printed in the notice is Md Hasan Ali Biswas. The notice does not name a funding agency.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice marks "Institute norms" as the eligibility norms for this position; "Funding Agency norms" is left unticked. The percentage or grade points for the academic qualification must be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Strong background in Harmonic Analysis Strong background in Functional Analysis Knowledge of Bishop-Phelps-Bollobás Property Knowledge of modulation spaces and Fock spaces The notice prints no experience requirement as essential. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact eligibility wording.

rows.essential_qualification: PhD in Mathematics with a specialization in Harmonic Analysis or Functional Analysis with a very good academic record throughout.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is advertised as a temporary position.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The primary responsibility of the candidate will be to actively collaborate on the research project titled "Bishop-Phelps-Bollobás Properties on Fock Spaces and Modulation Spaces". Additionally, the candidate may be assigned teaching assistant (TA) duties.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Applications are made through the application link given in the notice: http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ . The last date of application submission is 30-11-2026. The notice does not list the documents to be attached or describe the form-filling steps. For queries, the notice gives the contact Md Hasan Ali Biswas ( [email protected] ).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice does not describe the selection stages in detail. It states that merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment, and that a higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill a position through this round of selection, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is temporary: 1 year, extendable up to 2 years based on performance. The remuneration of 72000 - 84000/- is consolidated and includes HRA; the notice separately says House Rent Allowance per month (if applicable) is as per the institute norms. The candidate may be assigned teaching assistant (TA) duties in addition to the research work. A higher cutoff level than the minimum eligibility may be used for shortlisting.

faq.question: Q1. How many Post-Doctoral Fellow positions are advertised by IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 02 positions of Post-Doctoral Fellow in the Department of Mathematics under Advertisement No. IP/10594/Advt0380.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: The last date of application submission is 30-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: A PhD in Mathematics with a specialization in Harmonic Analysis or Functional Analysis with a very good academic record throughout, with a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration including HRA is 72000 - 84000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: Apply through the application link http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ on or before 30-11-2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls it a temporary position, with a duration of 1 year, extendable up to 2 years based on performance.

faq.question: Q7. Which project is the Post-Doctoral Fellow hired for?
faq.answer: The fellow works on "Bishop-Phelps-Bollobás Properties on Fock Spaces and Modulation Spaces", with Md Hasan Ali Biswas as PI in the Department of Mathematics.

faq.question: Q8. Will the Post-Doctoral Fellow have teaching duties?
faq.answer: The candidate may be assigned teaching assistant (TA) duties in addition to collaborating on the research project.

faq.question: Q9. Does meeting the minimum eligibility guarantee selection?
faq.answer: No. The notice says meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment, and a higher cutoff level may be used.
